Numbered, timed progress step

Source: R/utils_display.R
dot-cat_step.Rd

Announce one step of a longer computation. The step is marked done, with its elapsed time, when the next step starts or when the calling function returns; an error marks it failed. A wrapper of cli::cli_progress_step() that numbers steps and honours verbose.

Usage

.cat_step(
  msg,
  i = NULL,
  n = NULL,
  msg_done = msg,
  verbose = TRUE,
  .envir = parent.frame()
)

Arguments

msg

Character. Step description. cli inline markup and glue interpolation are evaluated in .envir, so "Fitting {n} models" picks up n from the caller. Text that cli cannot parse, such as data that contains braces, is shown as written.

i, n

Optional step number and total, shown as a grey [i/n] prefix ([i] when n is NULL).

msg_done

Character. Text shown when the step completes; defaults to msg. It takes the same prefix.

verbose

Logical. If FALSE, print nothing.

.envir

Environment whose exit ends the step and in which msg is interpolated. Defaults to the caller of .cat_step(); a helper that calls .cat_step() for its own caller passes its parent.frame().

Value

The cli progress bar id, invisibly (NULL when verbose = FALSE).

See also

Other console display: .cat_box(), .cat_formula(), .cat_line(), .cat_message(), .cat_saved(), .cat_tb()

Examples

fit_all <- function() {
  .cat_step("Fitting models", i = 1, n = 2)
  Sys.sleep(0.1)
  .cat_step("Drawing plot", i = 2, n = 2, msg_done = "Drew plot")
  invisible()
}
fit_all()
#> ℹ [1/2] Fitting models
#> ✔ [1/2] Fitting models [130ms]
#> 
#> ℹ [2/2] Drawing plot
#> ✔ [2/2] Drew plot [15ms]
#>
